subject: Weekly priorities snapshot + QBR deck inputs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly priorities snapshot + QBR deck inputs

Team —

Quick, compact update ahead of the QBR pack deadline next Wednesday. I kept this tight (wins / risks / asks) so leadership can slot 1–2 bullets directly into the QBR slides.

Wins
- Dedicated onboarding: PROD migration for the first Dedicated customer completed; 95% of routes under the new routing policy are stable (latency median within SLO).
- Optimize pilot: Redwood Optimize pilot reduced token cost by ~18% on the beta workload after enabling prefix caching and config tweaks.

Risks / near-term blockers
- Capacity: We see two burst windows where Dedicated pools could hit soft limits if queued jobs spike — this affects predictable throughput for three mid-market accounts.
- Quality regression risk: A small regression surfaced for long-context summarization on the 8k models after an internal kernel tweak; failing cases are reproducible but low-frequency.
- QBR narrative gap: We don't yet have a single customer-facing metric that ties Optimize savings to ARR impact (we have estimates but need a concise slide).

Asks (what I need from leadership or owners)
1) Ops: Markus / Soojin — confirm whether we can temporarily bump dedicated burst capacity for the two impacted customer cohorts for next 7 days (preferable ASAP).
2) Research: Vanessa — can you give a one-line explanation for the regression root cause and mitigation ETA (for the QBR commentary)?
3) Analytics: Laura — need a short metric: "estimated ARR protected by Optimize pilot" (single number + 1-sentence methodology) by EOD Monday so we can include it in the QBR finance slide.

Attachments: I attached a compact draft deck and a talking-points doc (named in attachments). Please add 1 slide / 2 bullets max if you want something pulled into the executive deck.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly priorities snapshot + QBR deck inputs

On Fri, 10 May 2028 at 09:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick, compact update ahead of the QBR pack deadline next Wednesday. I kept this tight (wins / risks / asks) so leadership can slot 1–2 bullets directly into the QBR slides.
> 
> Wins
> - Dedicated onboarding: PROD migration for the first Dedicated customer completed; 95% of routes under the new routing policy are stable (latency median within SLO).
> 
Thanks for the crisp note. Two quick clarifications that I need before I pull anything into the exec deck:

- For the Dedicated onboarding win, can you provide the name of the customer we can call out (or say "early enterprise pilot") and one sentence on the business impact (e.g., retention risk reduced / pipeline acceleration)?
- For the Optimize savings ask, if Analytics can't produce an ARR-protected number by Monday, what alternative single metric can we show that still communicates impact (e.g., % token-cost reduction on pilot workloads + sample customer count)?

If you can drop updated lines into the talking-points doc, I'll incorporate them into the finance and customer slides.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly priorities snapshot + QBR deck inputs

On Fri, May 10, 2028 at 10:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the crisp note. Two quick clarifications that I need before I pull anything into the exec deck:

Thanks — answers inline and uploaded a v1.1 of the deck to the Drive link.

- Customer callout: Please use "EdgeScale (early Dedicated pilot)" — business impact: decreases expected go-live friction and reduces churn risk for a top-10 mid-market account; expected to shorten onboarding by ~4–6 weeks on average.

- Alternative metric for finance slide: If Analytics can't deliver ARR-protected estimate by Monday, we can use "pilot cohort: 18% avg token-cost reduction; affects 4 pilot customers representing ~0.4% of ARR" (this is conservative and sourced from the Optimize pilot dashboard).

Attached: 2028_Q2_priority_deck_v1.1.xlsx (minor edits) and qbr_talking_points_v1.1.md (one-line customer & metric inserted).

I'll also add a 1-line root cause note for the regression and a short mitigation plan for Vanessa to expand if desired. ETA for regression fix: preliminary patch staged; ETA 72 hours (low-confidence until further repro work completes).

Karthik
